summary: Apply one or more line-range edits to a markdown file.

input_schema.file_path: string | The full path of the file to edit.

edits.description: A sequence of line-range edits to apply to the file.

start_line.description: The 1-based starting line number of the edit.

end_line.description: The 1-based ending line number of the edit.

content.description: The new content to replace the specified lines.

input_schema.if_revision: string | optional | Only edit the file if its current revision matches this value.
input_schema.force: boolean | optional | Force the edit, ignoring revision conflicts. Defaults to false.

output_schema.path: string | The full path of the file.
output_schema.content: string | The content of the file.
output_schema.size_bytes: integer | The size of the file in bytes.
output_schema.created_at: date-time|null|optional | The timestamp when the file was created.
output_schema.updated_at: date-time|null|optional | The timestamp when the file was last updated.
output_schema.revision: string | The revision identifier for the file.
